urls.rationale: Article 1 General Provisions: definitions and foundational rules for the lobbying chapter.
Article 2 Registration: core lobbyist/principal registration requirements.
Article 3 Prohibitions and Restrictions: lobbying-conduct prohibitions including gift ban.
Article 4 Reporting: core lobbying expenditure/activity reporting requirements.
Article 5 Liaison Personnel: registration/reporting regime for state-agency liaison personnel.
Article 6 Violations and Enforcement: penalties and enforcement authority for lobbying violations.
Article 7 Exemptions: statutory exemptions from the lobbying registration/reporting regime.
Article 8 Miscellaneous: residual lobbying-disclosure provisions (e.g., reportable expenditures by exempt persons).

notes: All 8 articles of Chapter 120C are in-scope lobbying-disclosure content; entire chapter is lobbying-only so all marked core_chapter. Article-set identical to NC 2015. 2010 slug convention drops hyphens (article1 vs article-1).
